Adjusted funds from operations, or AFFO, per share landed at US$1.12 for the quarter, and management inched full year AFFO guidance higher. items.title: 4 Monthly Dividend Stocks That Could Pay You Like Clockwork in Retirement
items.summary: Most dividend stocks pay quarterly, leaving retirees to juggle bills against an awkward schedule. These four REITs flip that problem by landing checks at different points every single month, but only if each one can keep covering its payout through rising interest costs and shifting tenant risks.
